name: VFX — Recogida de Pickup
generation_strategy: 2 frames individuales (en blanco — se tinta en Phaser) → script ensambla spritesheet horizontal 160×80

frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX pickup collect effect frame 1 of 2, top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant cartoon FX. Peak burst: a bold 8-pointed geometric star burst — clean sharp points, pure white-to-light-gray, white glowing center. Rendered in white and light gray only — will be tinted green (#44DD00) or blue (#2288FF) in-engine. Crisp, punchy, readable at 80x80px. NO color, NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, colored, smoke, explosion, background, text, watermark

frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX pickup collect effect frame 2 of 2, top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant cartoon FX. Particle scatter: 8-10 small round white glowing dots scattered outward from center at various distances, each with a soft white glow halo, mostly transparent canvas. Rendered in white only — will be tinted in-engine. NO color, NO starburst rays, NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, colored, starburst rays, dense, background, text, watermark

phaser_config.tint: 0x44DD00 (verde) para ammo pickups | 0x2288FF (azul) para wall pickups
